quote: I tried messaging the host, but there was no phone number to call and I didn’t receive a response.
Communication was prompt but quite impersonal.
I also could not access the spa, which was advertised in the booking and one of the main reasons for booking, which was disappointing.
Great communication from hotel staff upon check in.
Finding the car park and key collection was very stressful and took us over an hour.
Also it was difficult to find the lockbox shop at check-in and when requested for 2 hrs delay in checkout the host asked for extra charges.
There were no instructions regarding access to the pool and the host didn’t even know what to to do it was very frustrating and disappointing.
Check in was delayed and a cupboard missing in the kitchen.
Great location and check-in was really easy - he was also very flexible.
Dirty floors, mould in the shower grouting and accumulated dust under beds and on surfaces.
There was rubbish left behind in bins from previous guest, dirty towels in cupboard, and stains on the duvet, and no remote for the television.
However, there was a bit of an unpleasant smell when we first arrived, possibly leftover from the cleaning.
Very clean apartment, answered all my questions fast and was exactly like pictures.
The rubbish chute was used ALLL night and the noise was so very bad.
Unfortunately we were staying here at a time of construction, so very noisy at 7:30 am.
The mattress and pillows in the second bedroom are poor quality added to the poor sound insulation and inefficient air conditioning meant my daughter didn’t sleep well.
Great stay with a great view, comfortable and surprisingly quiet.
On top of that, there was no airflow in the apartment as we couldn’t open the windows and the air conditioning was broken, making the heat even worse.
The mattress sagged badly in the middle, making it uncomfortable, especially for those with back issues.
The only issues we had were both showers leaking badly and unfortunately the pool wasn’t heated so we could only use the spa.
It was spacious enough for our whole family, and we loved how comfortable and cozy everything felt.
It was also disappointing to find out that Airbnb guests weren’t able to use the amenities on weekends.
Decent location and fairly clean, but a very basic experience that was made worse because there was no working internet for our 4 days that we stayed there.
The listing mentioned a fully equipped kitchen, but the pots and pans provided were quite worn out and not really suitable for use.
The space was very clean and well-maintained, with great amenities that made everything comfortable and easy.
But the customer service and the receptionist are not friendly and polite.
our only problem was that our tv didn’t work and when we called staff up to help look at it she seemed really annoyed by this request.
It took 3wks many messages and many hours sitting around waiting for technicians and staff to finally fix problems.
The host was helpful and proactive in communication.
There was a coffee machine but no coffee pods.
No tea or coffee, no extra details, just the bare minimum.
The apartment was very clean and tidy, and we appreciated the generous supplies of tea, coffee, etc.
Only downside was the trains at night were nonstop and there was no aircon for inside the bedroom, with the blinds shut it got quite stuffy.
The location is very convenient, the room is very comfortable, but the elevator is old and slow, and the parking lot downstairs smells bad
It was also super close to public transport which made getting around a treat!
There are car parks around but no recommendations were provided.
No parking spot was definitely a negative & added an extra expense to our trip.
Only problem they charged seperate for the car park.
Great stay with everything we needed - secure parking, walkable location, washer/dryer was handy.
Furniture however was cheap, sparse, mismatched and just thrown together which is a shame.
No Airbnb touches, stains on the carpet, marks on walls, worn furniture, cheap products.
Amazing view of the city, definitely worth the price!!!
The couch is extremely worn out and not as the photos show and dining table is definitely old with heat damage and chipped wood.
The apartment did not look like the pictures, no plants or any type of decor- very bland.
Presentation is not like the photos with scruffy bedding and a mixture of uncomfortable pillows.
Great location, the place was clean and exactly as described.
